{{Challenge info

'''Mad World''' is a [[Challenge Deck]]. It bans most forms of earning money, but supplies an [[Eternal]], [[Negative]] {{Sticker|Eternal|image=Pareidolia (Negative).png|link=Pareidolia|name=Pareidolia|showtooltip=1}} and Eternal {{Sticker|Eternal|image=Business Card.png|link=Business Card|name=Business Card|showtooltip=1}} to assist with economy.

== Starting Contents ==
The starting deck contains 32 cards in total, consisting of ranks 2 through 9 in each suit.

== Synergies ==
===[[Jokers]]===
Because remaining hands no longer earn money, scaling {{Chips|+}} and {{Mult|+}} Jokers become considerably stronger here as players can waste all hands to scale them without any penalty.
*{{j|Reserved Parking}} will provide additional income in addition to {{j|Business Card}}.
*{{J|Oops! All 6s}}, combined with the Eternal {{j|Business Card}} and {{j|Pareidolia}}, guarantees that every card earns {{Money|2}} on scoring.
**Additionally, with the {{j|Reserved Parking}} synergy stated above, this also guarantees every card held in hand to earn {{Money|1}} after a hand is played.
*{{J|Splash}} lets you play five-card hands that don't score very well, if the only thing you are trying to do with the hand is to earn money and not score.
**Retrigger jokers such as {{J|Hanging Chad}} or {{J|Seltzer}} can help even further when earning money with the {{J|Business Card}} by playing hands.
*{{j|Midas Mask}} works well together with the {{j|Pareidolia}}, being able to give a consistent source of income.
**This allows Jokers like {{J|Golden Ticket}}, {{J|Vampire}} and {{J|Driver's License}} to be more useful too.
*Any Joker that benefits from Face Cards is useful for this challenge, be it {{j|Scary Face}}, {{j|Smiley Face}}, {{j|Sock and Buskin}}, etc.
*Jokers that rely on many number cards such as {{j|Fibonacci}}, {{j|Even Steven}}, and {{j|Odd Todd}} are stronger on this deck, as those three Jokers affect half of the deck rather than only 20/52 cards in a normal deck.
*{{j|Mail-In Rebate}} picks a random rank in the deck every round, which is considerably easier to find with only 8 ranks in this deck.
*Just a simple discard joker like {{J|Drunkard}} lets you practically see all of your deck without needing to play throwaway hands. {{J|Merry Andy}} also works, but is usually overkill and comes at the cost of decreased hand size. 
*{{J|The Idol}} has fewer options to choose from, making it more useful without needing to significantly manipulating the deck.
*{{J|Canio}} gains {{xmult|1}} when any card is destroyed. However, this can be dangerous due to the small deck.

== Anti-Synergies ==
===Jokers===
*{{J|Ride the Bus}} will never gain anything due to the eternal Pareidolia.
*{{J|To the Moon}} should be avoided as this challenge does not generate interest.
*{{J|Vagabond}} is hard to use due to Business Card providing lots of money during the blind. {{J|Credit Card}} can loosen the burden of it, however.
*Due to the small size of the deck, {{J|Erosion}} will have a lower ceiling on its maximum Mult.
**Similarly, {{J|Blue Joker}} does not work well in this challenge due to the small size of the deck.
*{{j|Scholar}} and {{J|Superposition}} require Aces, which this deck does not start with.
*{{j|Walkie Talkie}} requires 10s and 4s, but this deck does not start with any 10s.
*{{j|Baron}}, {{j|Shoot the Moon}}, {{j|Hit the Road}} and {{j|Triboulet}} all rely on specific ranks of face cards, but this deck lacks them.

===Vouchers===
*{{V|Seed Money}} and {{V|Money Tree}} work towards Interest, which is banned here.

===Boss Blinds===
*{{Blind|The Mark}} is a particularly dangerous boss in this challenge, as it essentially means that all of your cards will be drawn face down.

== Trivia ==
* The title is likely a reference to the Tears for Fears song [[wikipedia:Mad World|Mad World]], which begins with the line "All around me are familiar faces", here referring to face cards.
* This challenge deck in particular has only 32 cards, making it the smallest challenge deck.
